observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The lens barrel has '18-55mm' printed on it. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 800D' visible. The lens cap is on, showing 'Canon' branding.
Photo 1: Back view of the camera, showing the LCD screen, control buttons, and the rear grip. The camera body has 'Canon' branding. The screen is off, reflecting purple light. The lens is attached.
Photo 2: Front view of the camera, similar to photo 0, with the lens cap on. The lens barrel has '18-55mm' printed on it. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 800D' visible. The lens cap is on.
All photos show the camera held in a hand, with a glass display cabinet and boxes of Canon and Nikon cameras in the background.
The lens appears to be a standard 18-55mm kit lens, commonly used with Canon DSLRs.
The camera body shows no visible damage or wear in the photos, but no close-up of the sensor, shutter, or internal components is shown.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show the Canon EOS 800D model name on the camera body. Photo 0 and photo 2 show the lens barrel with '18-55mm' printed on it. The camera appears clean and undamaged in the photos.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera turning on, screen displaying, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus or scratches not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially at the edges and corners, under bright light.

risks.risk: Camera may have hidden mechanical or electronic faults (e.g., shutter, sensor, memory card)
risks.proof: Video showing the camera menu, shutter count, and sensor check (if possible).

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger, and a video showing the camera powering on with battery.

proof_requests: Video showing the camera turning on, screen displaying, and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light to check for fungus or scratches.
Photo of the battery and charger, and a video showing the camera powering on with battery.
Photo of the camera's menu screen showing shutter count and sensor status.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
